findings.title: GAP: Same event shown as many separate cards
findings.evidence: Live edition: the Anthropic IPO appears at Top ranks 7, 9, 22, 26, 36, 52, 63 (Guardian, CNBC x2, NYT x2, BBC, TechCrunch) and again in AI (The Decoder 'IPO with shares priced $70-$78') and Blogs (Stratechery). The Nvidia/Huang spy story appears at ranks 10, 53, 67, 72, 73, 83, 87, 95. Ranker.sameStory (Ranker.swift:120-126) needs 3 or more shared title tokens and 0.4 IDF overlap, so different angles on one event never merge. Competitors (Google News, Particle, Techmeme) show these as 1 cluster each.
findings.recommendation: Cluster on the server, at two levels. (a) Keep the current headline match for near-duplicate articles. (b) Group into events with embeddings: the first 300 characters of each story, cosine similarity 0.78 or higher within 48 hours, or ask the NVIDIA LLM once per run to assign each new article to an existing event_id or 'new'. Emit edition.json as an events[] list, each with members[], an LLM headline written from all members, a 60-word summary, and an updatedAt.

findings.title: GAP: Edition never ends and old stories stay in Top
findings.evidence: Live edition: 91 Top cards and 226 total. Top cards are up to 74 hours old (ages in hours: ...36, 37, 59, 74). Ranker.score divides by (ageHours+12), so a 3-day-old story keeps about 14% of its score. Low-value stories rank high, for example Engadget 'average lifespan of recordable Blu-ray discs' at #11. Apple News Today shows about 6-8 stories, TLDR 10-15, Inshorts an estimated 10-20 tech stories a day.
findings.recommendation: Cap the Top tab at 25 events. Hard-drop anything older than 36 hours unless its cluster got a new member in the last 6 hours. Add a 'newsworthiness' gate in enrich.py: the LLM scores 0-3 for 'is this news for a tech/startup professional' and anything below 2 leaves Top. Then show 'All caught up · Back at 6 PM for the evening gist'.

findings.title: GAP: Story length is inconsistent and fallback text is junk
findings.evidence: LLM summaries run 39-99 words, median 65, against Inshorts' 60. 66 of 226 articles have no headline or summary and show raw RSS: 15 Top items such as NYT 'Toyota Plans to Sell a Kei Pickup Truck' (ranked #0) and HN text 'Previously: .name Termination - https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=...'. CardView.swift:37-41 uses lineLimit(10) and minimumScaleFactor(0.85), so long summaries shrink or get cut off.
findings.recommendation: enrich.py: require 55-62 words, count them, retry once, and on failure trim at a sentence boundary. Headline 50-75 characters. Never publish an event without an LLM summary; hold it until the next 30-minute run instead. Remove the minimumScaleFactor and design the card for exactly 60 words at Dynamic Type Large.

findings.title: GAP: Notifications are late, plain and not rich
findings.evidence: BreakingNews.swift:5-6 states that timing depends on when iOS runs the refresh. DailyDigest.swift:62-66 sets earliestBeginDate to 1 hour, and iOS often delays it further. The alert is title 'Source + N more', body = headline, sound .default, no image, no thread, no interruption level (BreakingNews.swift:47-53). Competitors send server push with an image thumbnail, publisher attribution and a deep link into the in-app story, about 2-3 a day.
findings.recommendation: Send real APNs pushes from the Linux box: token auth with a .p8 key from the Apple developer account (free), HTTP/2 to api.push.apple.com, using curl or Python httpx in publish.sh. Store device tokens in the existing repo or a small endpoint. Add a Notification Service Extension that downloads the 720px JPEG as a UNNotificationAttachment. Set thread-id per event and relevance-score. Use interruption-level 'time-sensitive' only for 5+-outlet breaking events and 'passive' for the digests. Bundle a custom short .caf chime under 1 second.

findings.title: GAP: No India sources for a Bengaluru audience
findings.evidence: FeedSource.swift has 27 feeds, all US/UK or company blogs, with none of Inc42, YourStory, Entrackr, ET Tech, Moneycontrol Tech, The Ken, MediaNama or TechCrunch India. Live Startups content is TechCrunch Startups (12) and Product Hunt (12). Inshorts' tech and startup sections are India-first.
findings.recommendation: Add Inc42, Entrackr, YourStory, ET Tech and MediaNama RSS feeds (Startups/Top). Add a region setting (Bengaluru / Bay Area / Both) that boosts the score of India-tagged clusters by 1.5x and sets the digest time zone.

findings.title: GAP: Card and motion polish below Inshorts and Apple News
findings.evidence: CardView.swift: a flat card with the image on the top 40%, a title3 headline and secondary body text. Animation is only easeIn(0.2) on image load (line 95) and default paging (ContentView.swift:131). There is no haptics (no sensoryFeedback anywhere), no hero or matched-geometry transition into the reader, no parallax, and no progress indicator. Read opens SFSafariViewController in a sheet (ContentView.swift:56).
findings.recommendation: Add .sensoryFeedback(.selection) on each page change and .impact on bookmark. Add an image parallax (scrollTransition scaling 1.0 to 1.08 with y offset). Add a top progress bar for 'story 4 of 25'. Use matchedGeometryEffect from the card image into an in-app reader that shows the cluster's sources before opening Safari. Show a skeleton shimmer while loading. Use a 'NEW' / 'DEVELOPING' / 'BREAKING' badge row with a spring animation.
